limitations: This corpus is for the explicitly requested personal Mac test. It is not approved for Store distribution.
Community labels and free downloads do not establish redistribution permission; creator rights remain pending.
Direct official-platform/release packs and two source-release-linked ambiguous packs are excluded explicitly.
Fan remakes, contests and custom originals remain community candidates unless a complete parsed record exactly matches an excluded or pinned official source.
Canonical matching preserves title, skills, positions and other parsed fields. Retitled, modified or unsupported conversions may remain unidentified.

All retained ZIP bytes remain unchanged because native mechanics and saved identities depend on their original hashes. Runtime entryExclusions hide exact matches, but those records remain inside mixed ZIP bytes.
The legacy level-count index is retained as the baseline; native decoder count differences are recorded and require review.
No claim is made that all original-derived designs have been eliminated or that each level has a winning route.
Most packs still need original terrain, objects and destruction masks supplied separately for this private test.
